[[Holt the Iron Boot Heel]] is a [[White Mantle]] [[boss]] that is part of the expedition seeking to gain access to the [[Henge of Denravi]] ahead of the [[Shining Blade]].

*[[Justiciar's Armor]]
*[[Knight's Armor]]
*[[White Mantle Badge]]
*[[White Mantle Emblem]]

==Notes==
*Holt may randomly spawn in one of the points marked on the map. He shares them with [[Cuthbert the Chaste]], [[Garr the Merciful]], [[Kenric the Believer]], [[Lars the Obeisant]], and [[Manton the Indulgent]]. As such, there is a chance that Holt will not spawn at all.
